messages:
maria_support: FYI ACME (acct: acme-88) reporting deleted objects still showing in search after TTL expired. They want either an immediate purge or confirmation they're preserved for legal. Repro steps + logs below. tagging @lina_privsec for legal hold opinion :exclamation:

sophie_engineer: ugh. do we have request id / sample object ids?

maria_support: sample IDs: obj_7f3a2, obj_a9d1b. Repro steps: 
1) GET /v1/objects/obj_7f3a2 -> 404 
2) GET /v1/search?q=obj_7f3a2 -> returns result with metadata and _deleted: true
3) storage list shows tombstone created at 2026-03-15T10:12:04Z

Logs: 
```
search-indexer: info propagate tombstone obj_7f3a2 at seq 582931
search-indexer: warn reindex delayed due to decrypt error for shard s12
kms-client: error ENCRYPTION_KEY_UNAVAILABLE key=kms-rot-2026-03-15 code=52
storage-ttl: info tombstone queued for purge after grace window
```

maria_support: Customer says UI still displays the cleared record in their app (search hits), screenshots attached in ticket. They want timeline for full purge or a way to mark as preserved.

ajay_sre: likely indexer propagation + KMS rotation race. If tombstone was written but indexer couldn't decrypt some fields during rotation, the index may have kept an entry flagged _deleted:true. That explains 404 at storage + visible search row. We need to confirm whether tombstone propagation succeeded to all index shards.

ajay_sre: quick checks: run `curl -H "X-Request-ID: debug123" https://search.internal/v1/doc/obj_7f3a2` on s12, s13. Also check indexer metrics: `indexer.replica_lag` and `indexer.decrypt_errors` for last 6h.

dylan_infra: we are mid-KMS rotation for primary key (started 2026-03-15 09:50 UTC). HSM cluster had a transient outage at 10:05 UTC causing queued decrypts. Backlog is draining but some index shards still seeing decrypt failures. We're prioritizing writes but reads that require re-encryption may fail. ETA to finish key import: ~25m.

lina_privsec: put immediate legal hold on the ACME objects while we triage? If customer requests preservation, we must disable purge for those object IDs and export audit log. @maria_support can you confirm ACME requested preservation or they want deletion?

customer_acme: They want confirmation the data is preserved for litigation hold — do not delete. We opened a legal request via support ticket earlier today.

maria_support: confirming: ACME requests preservation. Please pause any purge actions for acct acme-88 and objects matching prefix obj_* until legal confirms.

ajay_sre: action plan: 
- pause tombstone sweeper for acme-88 (manual override) -> I can run `sweeper --pause --org acme-88` now.
- force reindex of obj_7f3a2 on affected shards after KMS rotation completes. command: `indexer.reindex --ids obj_7f3a2,obj_a9d1b --shards s12,s13 --retries 5`
- export audit logs for last 48h and push to legal bucket: `/audit/exports/acme-3067890123.zip`
- notify customer with current ETA (KMS finish + reindex) ~30-40m

maria_support: @dylan_infra can you confirm you can hold sweeper? We need a graceful pause not to leave global sweeper paused.

dylan_infra: yes I will apply a scoped pause to acme-88 now. running: `orchestrator set-sweeper-state --org acme-88 --state paused --reason "legal hold (ticket RET-4521)"`

dylan_infra: done. scoped pause applied. sweeper shows paused for acme-88 across regions.

ajay_sre: once KMS rotation is done we'll run the reindex and then verify `search.verify --id obj_7f3a2` returns `_deleted:true` and no public content. If index still surfaces other fields, we'll scrub searchable fields.

lina_privsec: also export KMS rotation audit and key IDs. legal wants proof rotation didn't re-encrypt to an unrelated key that could affect retention semantics.

maria_support: i'm drafting reply to ACME: "We've paused purge for your org and opened an internal investigation. We're awaiting KMS rotation completion (~30m) and will reindex impacted objects. We'll send an audit export to your legal contact and confirm next steps." want to send now or wait for dylan confirmation?

dylan_infra: send after I confirm reindex scheduled. I'll ping when reindex job queued (should be <10m after rotation).

retention-bot: Ticket RET-4521 created: "ACME - visible deleted objects during KMS rotation; legal hold requested." Owner: ajay_sre. Priority: P1. Related alerts: indexer.decrypt_error spike.

maria_support: assigned. @lina_privsec please let us know if legal needs different export format.

lina_privsec: export JSONL with event-level hashes + signed timestamp. I'll coordinate with legal and confirm.

customer_acme: thanks — we need confirmation email to our counsel (counsel@acme.com) when export is ready.

maria_support: noted, will include counsel. I'll update ticket and ping when reindex completes. :white_check_mark:
